edges.reason: withdrawBalance is gated by onlyCLevel, which compares msg.sender against ceoAddress/cooAddress before transferring funds.
onlyCEO modifier requires msg.sender to equal ceoAddress.
setCOO is guarded by onlyCEO which reads msg.sender.
transfer requires _owns(msg.sender,_tokenId).
transferFrom requires _approvedFor(msg.sender,_tokenId).
approve requires _owns(msg.sender,_tokenId).
onlyDopeRaiderContract requires msg.sender to equal districtContractAddress.
onlyDopeRaiderContract requires msg.sender to equal districtContractAddress.
updateNarco requires msg.sender to be the narco owner.
recruitNarco requires msg.sender to be the narco owner.
growWeed requires msg.sender to be the narco owner.
refineCoke requires msg.sender to be the narco owner.
Fallback requires msg.sender to equal address(saleAuction).
msg.sender is the destination of the external balance transfer in withdrawBalance.
random() mixes block.blockhash and now into _seed, making it timestamp dependent.
growWeed requires now > cooldowns[1], a timestamp dependency.
refineCoke requires now > cooldowns[2], a timestamp dependency.
Cooldown deadlines are derived from block.timestamp and can be influenced by miners.
onlyCLevel reads ceoAddress while authorising the withdrawal.
onlyCLevel reads cooAddress while authorising the withdrawal.
setCEO writes the ceoAddress state variable.
setCOO is gated by onlyCEO, which reads ceoAddress.
onlyDopeRaiderContract compares msg.sender to districtContractAddress.
onlyDopeRaiderContract compares msg.sender to districtContractAddress.
whenPaused modifier reads the paused flag in setNewAddress.
whenGameNotPaused reads gamePaused for updateNarco.
whenGameNotPaused reads gamePaused for recruitNarco.
whenGameNotPaused reads gamePaused for growWeed.
whenGameNotPaused reads gamePaused for refineCoke.
updateNarco enforces msg.value >= personalisationCost.
growWeed enforces msg.value >= growCost and forwards growCost.
refineCoke enforces msg.value >= refineCost and forwards refineCost.
recruitNarco compares level against respectRequiredToRecruit.
random() reads and rewrites the _seed state variable.
getLevel reads narcos[_narcoId].stats.
growWeed mutates narcos storage fields.
refineCoke mutates narcos storage fields.
_transfer resolves and writes narco ownership derived from the narcos array.
_owns reads narcoIndexToOwner to authorise the transfer.
_owns reads narcoIndexToOwner to authorise transferFrom.
updateNarco ownership check reads narcoIndexToOwner.
recruitNarco ownership check reads narcoIndexToOwner.
growWeed ownership check reads narcoIndexToOwner.
refineCoke ownership check reads narcoIndexToOwner.
_transfer increments/decrements ownershipTokenCount.
transfer indirectly affects the ownership count consumed by balanceOf.
createGen0Auction calls saleAuction.createAuction.
_computeNextGen0Price reads saleAuction.averageGen0SalePrice().
_createNarco calls random() to derive skills and home location.
_createNarco calls _transfer to assign ownership of the new narco.
recruitNarco calls _createNarco after checks.
recruitNarco calls getLevel for the level threshold check.
createPromoNarco calls _createNarco after limit checks.
createGen0Auction calls _createNarco before setting up the auction.
createGen0Auction calls _computeNextGen0Price for the starting price.
updateNarco requires getLevel(_narcoId) >= changeIdentityNarcoRespect.
Crafting path reads helper functions such as getLevel/min used in the same core flow.
withdrawBalance executes the external transfer represented by the unsafe operation.
updateWeedTotal can underflow the uint16 weedTotal on subtraction.
updateCokeTotal can underflow the uint16 cokeTotal on subtraction.
growWeed adds uint8(yield) to weedTotal without overflow guard.
_transfer mutates ownershipTokenCount with unchecked increment/decrement.
random() produces miner-influenceable pseudo-randomness.
growWeed cooldown logic depends on block.timestamp.
refineCoke cooldown logic depends on block.timestamp.
growWeed performs an external value-bearing call to districtsCore.distributeRevenue.
refineCoke performs an external value-bearing call to districtsCore.distributeRevenue.
Fallback authorisation depends only on the msg.sender comparison.
growWeed calls getNarcoLocation, increaseDistrictWeed and distributeRevenue on districtsCore.
refineCoke calls getNarcoLocation, increaseDistrictCoke and distributeRevenue on districtsCore.
_newCEO parameter is assigned to ceoAddress.
_newCOO parameter is assigned to cooAddress.
_address parameter is used to build the candidate districts contract.
_narcoId parameter indexes the narcos array.
_total parameter is added to or subtracted from weedTotal.
_narcoId parameter indexes the narcos array in growWeed.
_narcoId parameter indexes the narcos array in refineCoke.
_narcoId parameter selects the narco to mutate in updateNarco.
_genes parameter is stored into narcos[_narcoId].genes.
yield local is cast to uint8 and cumulated into weedTotal.
district local is passed to districtsCore.increaseDistrictWeed.
growSkillLevel local drives maxYield and cooldown computation.
cooldown local is written back to narcos cooldowns using now.
avePrice local holds saleAuction.averageGen0SalePrice().
nextPrice local is derived from avePrice and returned.
newNarcoId local is the index of the pushed Narco struct.
_from parameter identifies the current owner in transferFrom.
_to parameter identifies the recipient in transferFrom.
_tokenId parameter selects the narco in transferFrom.

normalization_plan.reason: Parameter _newCEO is used only inside setCEO and can be folded into the function node.
Parameter _newCOO is used only inside setCOO and can be folded into the function node.
Parameter _address is used only inside _setDistrictAddresss and can be folded into the internal setter.
Parameter _narcoId is used only as an array index inside updateWeedTotal.
Parameter _total is used only in the weedTotal update inside updateWeedTotal.
Parameter _narcoId is used only as an array index inside growWeed.
Parameter _narcoId is used only as an array index inside refineCoke.
Parameter _narcoId is used only as an array index inside updateNarco.
Parameter _genes is stored directly by updateNarco and has no independent behaviour.
Local yield flows into the unchecked weedTotal addition modelled by the arithmetic unsafe operation.
Local district is consumed by the external districtsCore value call unsafe operation.
Local growSkillLevel is an internal temporary of growWeed.
Local cooldown is the timestamp-derived value modelled by the timestamp dependency unsafe operation.
Local avePrice is an internal temporary of _computeNextGen0Price.
Local nextPrice is an internal temporary of _computeNextGen0Price.
Local newNarcoId is an internal temporary of _createNarco.
Parameter _from is used only as the ownership source inside transferFrom.
Parameter _to is used only as the recipient inside transferFrom.
Parameter _tokenId is used only as the token selector inside transferFrom.
